info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Preapproval Listing API enables users to access a comprehensive list of preapproved mortgage loans. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about various mortgage options available for eligible borrowers. Typical consumers include financial institutions and mortgage service providers looking to evaluate and present available loan products. By leveraging this API, partners can enhance their services by providing clients with timely and accurate preapproval information.

get.summary: Retrieve preapproval status for loan applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the preapproval status for their loan applications, providing crucial information for potential borrowers before they proceed further.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a loan preapproval check. This body must contain the necessary information to evaluate eligibility for a loan preapproval.

200.description: Request completed successfully and loan preapproval details returned.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the preapproval operation in the loans API.

status.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the preapproval request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the preapproval operation.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the preapproval request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the status of the preapproval request.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for the GET preapproval operation, indicating the status and details of the loan preapproval request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was processed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details related to the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
